name: Street lamp
summary: Curved street lamp post with a dome head; anim lights switches the lamp on with a glow. For street and night scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the foot of the post stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: about 330 px wide and 1080 px tall at s = 1 (about 1.5 people tall at s = 1)

params.name: anim
params.note: lights = the lamp glows on, with its light cone and pool on the pavement; pop = scales in

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the arm reaches left

author: krakujs
